title: Axial CT Demonstrating Adrenal Hyperperfusion in Hypovolemic Shock
author: Hellerhoff
caption: Contrast-enhanced axial abdominal CT showing bilateral adrenal hyperperfusion and collapsed inferior vena cava characteristic of CT hypoperfusion complex in hypovolemic shock.
alt_text: Axial abdominal CT scan with bright contrast enhancement of both adrenal glands in a patient with hypovolemic shock.
clinical_relevance: Demonstrates diagnostic imaging findings of systemic hypoperfusion and compensatory catecholamine response in severe shock (CLIFF-016, p.1, p.8).
